se: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: Dead Woods Cass Mireles idle SE sprite, transparent background. Second reference is her rear pose for identity only; third is approved Eli at 2x for pixel detail and style. Charcoal shirt sleeves equally rolled to forearms; olive utility trousers, matching thigh pockets, matching knee braces, tan lace-up boots. Centred chest rig and holstered pistol, matching paired hip ammo pouches and thigh knife sheaths. Same pose and slim build as reference. Muted limited palette, crisp pixel clusters, no antialiasing, no gradients, no soft painting, no shadow, no floor, no text. Need substantive finer detail in clothing seams, braid, face and gear, NOT enlarged old pixels. Design for eventual 128x128 cell with top at row16, soles at112, centre anchor64. Enlarge this small sprite crisply on generation canvas, generous transparent margin, single character only.
